responsibility: Render provenance-grounded creation from a versioned bounded JSON envelope whose opaque paragraph source IDs were explicitly emitted and validated against the exact currently authorized submitted-input allow-list. Express multiple anchors plus cited/noSource/partialNoSource, route through current-policy revalidation, and preserve citation semantics across copy/export/share. Never infer sources by position, claim automatic fact verification, or claim a saved Note.

inputs.templateType: Preset creation template: letter | report | poem | timeline (US-SYN-003 AC-1)
inputs.sourceMemories: Current-policy-filtered retrieved memory summaries with opaque MemoryIDs; assetID/sourceLocator/source App identity never enters the model envelope
inputs.generatedContent: Versioned JSON CreativePipeline output bounded by raw bytes, paragraph count, paragraph characters and references per paragraph. Each paragraph has text + sourceMemoryIDs[]. Unknown version, malformed root or any limit breach fails the whole generation as L2. Validated output carries [SourceAnchor] plus cited/noSource/partialNoSource; fixture output is Preview/test-only.
inputs.promptDraft: Personalized System Prompt draft (US-SYN-005) — editable, confirm/reset

outputs.visibleContent: Template picker, generation progress, provenance-labelled source anchors, NoSource/partial-NoSource warnings, copy/export/share/Save to Notes handoff actions and honest error states. Allow-list membership is labelled Source memory, never Verified fact. Copy and export preparation revalidate current UserPolicy + PrivacyCheckpoint; revoked sources block derived-body handoff. Successful share-controller presentation callback writes creationSharePresented with structured sharePresented=true; Echo does not record activityType, target App, completion, content or source locators.
outputs.interactionTargets: creation-generate, creation-copy, creation-export, creation-save-to-notes, creation-retry, creation-edit-prompt, creation-confirm-prompt, creation-reset-prompt, creation-citation-anchor-*
outputs.accessibilityTree: Generated content exposes cited/noSource/partialNoSource and each valid source anchor without claiming factual verification; system share handoff is announced only after actual presentation and without claiming a final save result; prompt editor is editable text with confirm/reset actions

systemContainer: NavigationStack (pushed from MemoryDetailView creation entry) + ScrollView + Form sheet (prompt editor) + confirmationDialog (export format) + item-driven system share handoff
